## Stack
Detected: cloudflare, next, react, tailwind, vitest.
Tests run on Vitest; a change to logic ships with a test that fails without it.

### React / Vite

- Stable, unique keys in lists. Never array index if the list can be reordered.
- Every `useEffect` that subscribes or starts a timer MUST return a cleanup function.
- Derived state is computed during render, not duplicated into separate state.
- Never call hooks inside conditions, loops, or nested functions.
- Fetch in `useEffect` always handles the unmount case with a `cancelled` flag.
- `npm run build` locally before pushing. Pin dependency versions with `--save-exact` (no `^`, no `~`).
- Remove unused imports before committing. Lint should catch this; do not commit warnings.

### CSS / Tailwind

- Use browser dev tools for specificity conflicts, not guesswork.
- Every UI change lands in both the dedicated mobile and desktop versions ([[tech-stack]] §Build standard, 2026-09-13). Test the mobile version at 375px and 768px and the desktop version at 1440px. Breakpoint utilities tune a version; they do not replace one.
- Dark mode: every color utility needs a `dark:` variant.
- Z-index: define a scale in one place. No arbitrary values scattered across components.
- Ensure Tailwind config scans all files that use Tailwind classes.
- **Any stylesheet that sets `display` on components must also carry `[hidden] { display: none !important; }` once, globally (2026-07-31).** The `hidden` attribute is a UA default that any author `display` rule silently beats, so `<button hidden>` on a `display: inline-flex` class renders normally while `el.hidden = true` reports success. Caught on the CCAR-F practice app showing an empty-state control that should never have been visible. Nothing errors and nothing logs; only the rendered page shows it.
- Never `minmax(0, Nfr)` on a grid column holding primary content beside a tail of `auto` columns: on mobile the auto columns can consume the row and the fr column legitimately collapses to 0px. Set a real lower bound (`minmax(180px, 1.4fr)`) or stack the row below 640px. Tailwind responsive utilities cannot override inline `style={{ gridTemplateColumns }}`; breakpoint-varying templates live in a `<style>` block or CSS module. (2026-05-24, BuckBoard Ratios panel; full story in [[Tasks/lessons|lessons.md]])

### Cloudflare (Pages / Workers / D1)

- **Ship a served favicon with every deploy (2026-07-09, Max, recurring).** Put a real `/favicon.svg` in the served root, linked `type="image/svg+xml"` (plus a raster `.ico`/PNG fallback when tooling allows), and verify it returns 200 with `image/svg+xml` before declaring done. An inline `data:` URI favicon is unreliable in Chrome and ships a blank tab. Favicon is definition-of-done for any web surface, not optional polish.
- **Static-assets deploys cache HTML; add a no-cache `_headers` or updates look stale (2026-07-09).** For a Workers/Pages static-assets project whose content changes, ship `public/_headers` with `/*` then `Cache-Control: no-cache` so HTML revalidates and deploys show immediately. A `?query` cache-bust does NOT clear the edge asset cache; the authoritative check that a deploy landed is a cache-busted `curl` of the server bytes (grep the changed string), not the browser (browser/edge cache lies). Burned ~20 deploys of the cohort hub chasing "it went dark again" that was pure stale cache.
- **A per-path `_headers` rule is ADDED to the `/*` rule, never substituted for it (2026-07-31).** Workers Assets concatenates matching blocks per header name, so `/*` setting `Cache-Control: no-cache` plus `/favicon.svg` setting `public, max-age=86400` serves the self-contradicting `Cache-Control: no-cache, public, max-age=86400`. If one path needs a different value for a header, the wildcard must not set that header at all. Verify the served value with `curl -sI` after deploying; the file does not tell you what shipped.
- D1 is SQLite, accessed through **Drizzle** (schema file, generated types, `drizzle-kit` migrations) in every project that has been touched since June 2026. The old "raw and stringly-typed" state is history, corrected 2026-08-18. Any raw query still surviving in untouched code gets converted the next time a session changes that schema, per the trigger policy above. Validate inputs regardless; typed access removes the stringly-typed footgun, not the untrusted-input one.
- Workers AI, AI Gateway, and Vectorize are available on this account and are the intended differentiation surface for consulting work.
